about: Game bench: six original game-asset briefs (no character, franchise or brand) run by scripts/game_bench.py with a scripted agent. Each brief names its features in words (the router reads them), the cage or CAD the scripted agent builds (a generator in game_bench.py), the engine preset, the triangle budgets (LOD0 first) and the materials by region. Budgets and every threshold are proposed values; the first run confirms or changes them.
